bibl.title: Adverbs in -ως in Documents of Graeco-Roman Egypt
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas & Georgios Triantafyllou, Adverbs in -ως in Documents of Graeco-Roman Egypt = Ευλιμένη. Σειρά αυτοτελών εκδόσεων. 3.
Ρέθυμνο, Μεσογειακή Αρχαιολογική Εταιρεία, 2019, x-309 pp. ISBN 978-618-80666-4-9. €80.
bibl.note: Preface. Bibliography. - General introduction. - Catalogue of adverbs in -ως (with a focus on the adverbs used in the private letters of the Graeco-Roman Egypt). - Lists. - Appendices [N.L.]: 1. The adverbs ending in -ί and -εί, -δην and -δόν; - 2. Delenda adverbia. - Index of datable attestations and corrections. Reverse index. General index.
